address: Street 900, Bldg. No. 25, Zone 61, Al Dafna, Beachfront, InterContinental Doha, West Bay, Doha, Qatar
bio: Come for the beachfront location, stay for the vibrant Peruvian dishes at this light and airy restaurant within the grounds of the InterContinental Hotel. Gastón Acurio is a fine ambassador for Peruvian food and all bases are covered here, from ceviches to anticuchos. The colourful, rustic dishes deliver plenty of punchy flavours and are perfect for sharing. As you sit and soak up the lively atmosphere, you’ll be struck by what a fun night out it all is. And the wallet-friendly prices make it even more appealing....
